name: kxpahlavihead
title: Will Reza Pahlavi lead Iran in 2026?
settlement: This market resolves to Yes if Reza Pahlavi is appointed, elected, named, designated, or succeeded to the position of head of state or government of Iran before January 1, 2027. Otherwise it resolves to No. Resolution is based on official recognition of Pahlavi assuming leadership of Iran, not merely his public statements or opposition activity.
decideContext: You are estimating the probability (expressed in percentage points) that Reza Pahlavi becomes Iran's head of state or government before Jan 1, 2027; the market resolves Yes only on his actual installation into that role, not mere advocacy or exile politics.
